deadline.value: The CS graduate page gives April 15 for international fall applicants (August 1 for domestic); it does not separate the PhD from the MS.
deadline.quote: The application deadline is April 15th for international students and August 1st for domestic

gre_general.value: No GRE is required for CS graduate applicants.

entry_route.value: The PhD is counted from the bachelor's degree, with at least three years of full-time study beyond it.
entry_route.quote: This degree program requires a minimum of three years of full-time study beyond the bachelor's degree

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The page does not say whether a supervisor is needed before admission.

funding.value: The page does not say whether admitted PhD students are funded.

notes: Supervisor and funding for the PhD are not stated on the page; its assistantship text covers MS students.
